capabilities.description: What this bundle proves, and which adapter established each. Computed to decide phase readiness and previously discarded, so nothing downstream could tell an operator which evidence was already supplied.

assembly_version.description: A digest of the code that assembled the bundle. Part of the bundle identity, so a re-assembly of the same sources by different code is a different bundle rather than a path conflict; stated here because a digest cannot be read back out of an id.
